changes.name: Amy Williams - Duo
changes.public_note: Purchase performance materials by contacting Amy Williams through her [contact form](https://amywilliamsmusic.com/contact/).

changes.name: Anders Hillborg - Plainsong And Echoes
changes.public_note: Request the score and parts from [Faber Music’s Hire Library](https://www.fabermusic.com/music/plainsong-and-echoes). Faber lists them as a special sale for soprano saxophone (or oboe) and four cellos.

changes.file: content/works/Anthony R. Green - Verbinding ~32 apophthegms inspired by the Goldberg Variations.md
changes.name: Anthony R. Green - Verbinding ~32 apophthegms inspired by the Goldberg Variations
changes.public_note: Contact Anthony R. Green through his [contact page](https://www.anthonyrgreen.com/contact) or [email](mailto:anthony.r.green@gmail.com) for score purchase or rental. Request the alto saxophone and piano materials.

changes.name: Anthony R. Green - Weightless
changes.public_note: Contact Anthony R. Green through his [contact page](https://www.anthonyrgreen.com/contact) or [email](mailto:anthony.r.green@gmail.com) for score purchase or rental. Request the alto saxophone and piano materials.

changes.name: Dana Wilson - Calling, Ever Calling
changes.public_note: Order by [emailing Dana Wilson](mailto:wilson@ithaca.edu), using his [score-and-parts page](https://www.danawilson.org/composition_price_list/102049). This page offers the soprano saxophone and piano version. Ask separately about band or orchestral materials.

changes.name: Dana Wilson - Luminescence
changes.public_note: Order by [emailing Dana Wilson](mailto:wilson@ithaca.edu), using his [score-and-parts page](https://www.danawilson.org/composition_price_list/131). Specify whether you need piano or guitar accompaniment.

changes.file: content/works/Dana Wilson - Time Cries, Hoping Otherwise.md
changes.name: Dana Wilson - Time Cries, Hoping Otherwise
changes.public_note: Order the alto saxophone and piano version by [emailing Dana Wilson](mailto:wilson@ithaca.edu), using his [score-and-parts page](https://www.danawilson.org/composition_price_list/398). Ask separately about band materials.

changes.name: Frank Wiley - Portals of Light
changes.public_note: Contact Frank Wiley through the details on his [compositions page](https://www.frankwiley.com/compositions.html) to order the saxophone part and piano score.

changes.file: content/works/Gregory Wanamaker - Of Light and Shadows.md
changes.name: Gregory Wanamaker - Of Light and Shadows
changes.public_note: Contact Gregory Wanamaker through the link at the top of his [work page](https://gregorywanamaker.com/works/of-light-and-shadows/) to purchase the alto saxophone and piano score.

changes.name: Meyer Kupferman - Five Forms
changes.public_note: Request this work from Soundspells Productions at [carson@carsoncooman.com](mailto:carson@carsoncooman.com). Its [ordering page](https://www.soundspells.com/) directs requests for specific Kupferman works to this contact. Confirm the edition and included parts when ordering.

changes.name: Meyer Kupferman - In Two Bits
changes.public_note: Request this work from Soundspells Productions at [carson@carsoncooman.com](mailto:carson@carsoncooman.com). Its [ordering page](https://www.soundspells.com/) directs requests for specific Kupferman works to this contact. Confirm the edition and included parts when ordering.

changes.name: Nina Šenk - Impetus
changes.public_note: Contact [Nina Šenk](mailto:senk.nina@gmail.com) to purchase the score, as directed in her [chamber music catalog](https://ninasenk.net/works/chamber-music/). The catalog links a revised 2022 edition. Ask which edition will be supplied.

changes.name: Olivia Kieffer - 3 Pieces for Michael
changes.public_note: Email [Olivia Kieffer](mailto:livingcreaturespress@gmail.com) to order the soprano saxophone and piano materials. Her [works list](https://oliviakieffer.com/complete-works-list/) gives the instrumentation and ordering instructions.

changes.name: Olivia Kieffer - Floating Bones
changes.public_note: Email [Olivia Kieffer](mailto:livingcreaturespress@gmail.com) to order the unaccompanied alto saxophone score. Her [works list](https://oliviakieffer.com/complete-works-list/) provides the ordering instructions.

changes.name: Russell Peck - The Upward Stream
changes.public_note: Contact [Pecktackular Music](https://russellpeck.com/compositions/the-upward-stream/) at [peckmusic@russellpeck.com](mailto:peckmusic@russellpeck.com) for score sales or rental materials. Ask about the piano reduction or ensemble materials you need.
